      "id": "rc:1920344559",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "The rescan flag is overwritten on each descriptor iteration, making rescan behavior depend solely on the last descriptor in the batch.",
      "quote": "This overrides the flag for each imported descriptor, meaning the final value depends solely on the last imported element.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author fixed flag handling across batch descriptors",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:1923589979"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:1923589979",
      "status_by_quote": "Hi @furszy  I have updated the commit can you please review it once."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:1923704181",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Adding a separate rescan boolean silently ignores the timestamp parameter, confusing users.",
      "quote": "This seems confusing to users to silently ignore the timestamp. Why not simply have another timestamp value?",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author switched to using a timestamp value instead of a separate flag",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:1925324713",
        "rc:1977417409"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:1977417409",
      "status_by_quote": "Updated the code"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:1992051054",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Negative timestamps previously initiated a full chain rescan; skipping rescan when timestamps are negative silently breaks prior behavior.",
      "quote": "Seems a bit odd to skip rescan when all timestamps are negative. Previously, this would rescan the full chain.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated rescan logic to handle negative timestamps",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:1993202306",
        "rc:1995616163"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "rc:1992796261",
        "rc:1992994451",
        "rc:1995133082",
        "rc:1995170672",
        "rc:2023450051"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2038934208",
      "status_by_quote": "Hi @achow101 I've improved the logic and taken care your point as well."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2038172963",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Failed imports trigger rescans when prior behavior skipped rescanning on failed imports.",
      "quote": "The prior behavior would skip rescanning on failed imports. This seems to no longer be the case.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author improved logic to only rescan on successful imports",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2038934208"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2038934208",
      "status_by_quote": "Hi @achow101 I've improved the logic and taken care your point as well."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2141255267",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Tests do not distinguish between 'now' and 'never', failing to verify if rescanning actually worked as intended.",
      "quote": "The outcome of rescanning due to \"timestamp\": \"now\" should be different from the outcome of not rescanning due to \"timestamp\": \"never\". As it is now, both tests have the same outcome due to the setup,",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated functional tests based on rkrux's test diff",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2144239576",
        "rc:2592634616"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2592634616",
      "status_by_quote": "its done thanks for updated test cases."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2599095627",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "Adding a new timestamp validation error is unrelated to the 'never' timestamp change and should be in its own commit.",
      "quote": "This change should be in a different commit.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "rkrux requested changes noting furszy's comment on separate commit is still unaddressed",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2602958726",
        "c:3784594470",
        "c:3841929084"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "rc:2603013135",

        "r:3692418582",
        "c:3784460737",
        "r:3696179007",
        "rc:3298639322",
        "r:4357107633"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3298639322",
      "status_by_quote": "This is still not addressed, please address it."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:3552684128",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Use timestamp='new' instead of 'never'",
      "quote": "Instead of using `timestamp=never`, which is not really descriptive. What about using `new`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2644467615",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Immediately converting std::optional to -1 reintroduces magic numbers rather than properly checking optional values.",
      "quote": "The purpose of using an optional for `GetImportTimestamp` is to actually use the optional and check whether it has a value, not to immediately go back to essentially the original code with `-1` being a magic number.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author removed -1 magic number and used std::optional directly",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2652682509",
        "rc:2659331702"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "rc:2650897671",
        "rc:2659038094"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2659331702",
      "status_by_quote": "hi @furszy i'm not using -1 anymore can you please check latest commits."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2650914704",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Fallback value of -1 leaks into user-facing error messages for failed rescans.",
      "quote": "This seems problematic because an internal default value is being used here for user facing messages.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author applied suggested diff to skip error check for 'never' timestamps",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2652704337"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2652704337",
      "status_by_quote": "done and thanks for the suggestion"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3252928709",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Code may access std::nullopt without checking has_value() when 'never' timestamp is provided.",
      "quote": "isn't this going to access a `std::nullopt`? should be `request_timestamp.has_value()` because `GetImportTimestamp` returns nullopt only when \"never\" is provided?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author refactored code to check has_value()",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3254089060"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3254089060",
      "status_by_quote": "Hi @furszy I've refactored the code, could you please review that again."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3298620688",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "The functional test for never_funded_wallet expects balance 0 despite claiming there is pre-existing history because the key was never funded.",
      "quote": "If I use the following patch, the test passes but the expected balance should not be 0 because there's supposed to be a pre-existing history as per the code comment above.",

    }
  ]
}
